question: After geometry, low-frequency tone and edge controls, does the film side of the one-author weak pairs retain a cross-family stationary high-frequency excess worth approximating with an explicit density-domain structure model?

analysis.warp: digital encoded sRGB to film geometry using exact BO2 homography and OpenCV INTER_LINEAR
analysis.scene_weighting: equal scene weight; patches average within scene
analysis.jpeg_block_control: mean absolute adjacent difference at local 8-pixel boundaries divided by non-boundaries

branches.pass: freeze the measured generic capture-chain residual shape and preregister one mean-preserving density-domain stochastic structure challenger with shuffled-shape and monochrome controls
branches.fail: close this paired texture route without generator fitting; continue another explicit colour or physical mechanism
branches.nuisance_fail: classify the signal as alignment, edge, JPEG or family nuisance rather than film structure

forbidden: fit or tune thresholds from the formal report
call the residual a stock, emulsion, scanner-independent or calibrated grain response
train a neural texture generator or generate final RGB with ML
use hard clipping or display-RGB additive noise as the next renderer
claim_ceiling: one-author weak-paired camera-film-display-chain stationary texture identifiability evidence; not stock, emulsion, scanner, process, calibration, product or commercial-use evidence
